newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Jan copper center shipments up 8 pct over '96.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Jan copper center shipments up 8 pct over '96.

text.p: Average daily shipments of copper and brass mill products from U.S. service centers rose 28.9 percent in January from December, Copper and Brass Servicenter Association reported.
Total January shipments were 8.2 percent above January 1996. Copper shipments were 13.1 percent and alloy shipments up 6 percent above January 1996 levels.
Business was continuing to range from very good to fairly good in February so far, though there was softening in some areas, association members said.
The change in the total inventory picture for reporting service centers at the end of January showed only a slight decline, less than one percent, from a year ago.
